cards.title: OpenStax Chemistry 2e — Molecular Structure and Polarity; Hybrid Atomic Orbitals
supports: Single, double and triple bonds each count as one VSEPR electron-density region around a central atom.
Four electron-density regions correspond to tetrahedral electron-domain geometry.
Three regions map to the introductory sp2 model and four to sp3.
The number of hybrid orbitals formed equals the number of atomic orbitals combined.
VSEPR and hybridisation are models with distinct descriptive jobs; hybridisation rationalises geometry rather than replacing a full quantum description.

cards.title: OpenStax Chemistry: Atoms First 2e — Valence Bond Theory; Multiple Bonds
supports: Sigma overlap is oriented along the internuclear axis.
Pi overlap is side-by-side with electron density on opposite sides of the internuclear axis and a nodal plane containing that axis.
A multiple bond combines one sigma bond with pi bonding component(s) without creating extra VSEPR directions to additional neighbours.
